marketSummary: Benchmark indices consolidated above critical technical levels as Nifty 50 defended the 25,000 zone to close near 25,033 on Monday, November 9, 2026. Domestic equities are benefiting from a seven-session FII cash-buying streak totaling over ₹50,000 crore, alongside softer international crude prices near $93-95/barrel. Swing traders are seeing constructive base building across Defence and Capital Goods, while earnings-driven dispersion creates tactical multi-day setups in select industrial and consumer names.
dailyFocus: Track confirmation on high-volume pivots ahead of scheduled Q2 prints for defence heavyweights Cochin Shipyard (Nov 10) and HAL (Nov 12), while monitoring follow-through on BEL's ₹909-crore order inflow and CG Power's high-volume base advance.

news.headline: CG Power Advances 3.5% on Expanding Multi-Year Order Book and Data Center Transformer Push
news.summary: CG Power closed up 3.49% at ₹800 on Monday, November 9, 2026, underpinned by institutional accumulation following a 78% YoY surge in Q2 order intake to ₹8,485 crore, lifting total backlog to ₹23,646 crore. Strong demand for power transformers in global data centers and the commissioning of its Sehore capacity continue to drive top-tier relative strength.
news.impact: A clean multi-session volume expansion candle confirms accumulation, placing the stock in a favorable position to retest prior swing highs near ₹840-₹850.

news.headline: Tata Motors Surpasses 96% Stake in Iveco Group to Trigger Legal Squeeze-Out and Delisting
news.summary: Tata Motors confirmed that its subsidiary TML CV Holdings reached a 96.25% equity stake in Iveco Group N.V. following the completion of its reopened tender offer on November 9, 2026. Having breached the 95% threshold via a €262.13-million acceptance round, Tata Motors will execute a statutory Dutch squeeze-out to delist the global commercial vehicle manufacturer.
news.impact: Eliminates multi-month transaction overhang and positions the commercial vehicle arm for full operational integration, setting up an upside reversal watch off base support.

news.headline: Larsen & Toubro Wins ₹1,000-₹2,500 Crore Order for Noida Metro Aqua Line Extension
news.summary: Larsen & Toubro announced on Monday, November 9, 2026, that its Heavy Civil Infrastructure business secured a significant contract (classified as ₹1,000 to ₹2,500 crore) from Noida Metro Rail Corporation. The scope entails turnkey part design and construction of a 15.1-km elevated viaduct and 10 elevated metro stations over a 36-month execution horizon.
news.impact: Validates sustained civil infrastructure execution velocity and provides price support as the stock stabilizes around ₹4,130-₹4,150 technical support.

news.headline: Hindustan Aeronautics Schedules Board Meeting on November 12 to Approve Q2 FY27 Financials
news.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited has scheduled its board meeting for Thursday, November 12, 2026, to consider and approve unaudited quarterly financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026. The defence PSU is trading near its upper consolidation boundary with stable institutional participation ahead of the announcement.
news.impact: Provides a scheduled volatility event; swing traders should manage risk near the ₹5,000 zone as pre-earnings positioning tests base resistance.

news.headline: BHEL Bags ₹600-₹900 Crore Contract from Power Grid for Barmer HVDC Synchronous Condensers
news.summary: State-run Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited received a Notification of Award on November 7, 2026, from Power Grid Corporation for two synchronous condenser systems (+300/-200 MVAR) at the Barmer-II HVDC terminal station in Rajasthan. Valued between ₹600 crore and ₹900 crore, the project stabilizes grid renewable integration over a 44-month schedule.
news.impact: High-margin grid equipment wins strengthen technical setups in public-sector engineering counters, providing catalyst support for a breakout attempt above structural resistance.

news.headline: Bharat Electronics Secures Fresh Defence Orders Worth ₹909 Crore Across Critical Systems
news.summary: Bharat Electronics Limited disclosed under Regulation 30 that it has secured additional orders worth ₹909 crore since October 21, 2026. The contracts encompass Stabilized Optronic Pedestals, tactical communication equipment, navigation systems, night vision devices, software packages, and spares, boosting an unexecuted order book that stood at ₹68,717 crore at the end of H1 FY27.
news.impact: Reinforces the stock's multi-week constructive cup pattern near ₹400, offering strong odds for swing volume expansion on intraday dips.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard Board to Meet on November 10 for Q2 FY27 Results and Interim Dividend Consideration
news.summary: Cochin Shipyard informed the exchanges that a board meeting is scheduled on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, to review and approve unaudited Q2 FY27 standalone and consolidated financial results and evaluate an interim dividend. Concurrently, shareholders ratified the postal ballot on November 7 for transferring the ₹1,800-crore ISRF undertaking into a 50:50 joint venture with Drydocks World.
news.impact: A decisive catalyst candle is anticipated around the earnings release; watching for continuation volume if the stock clears the ₹1,260-₹1,300 overhead hurdle.

news.headline: Trent Consolidates Near Base Lows Post Q2 Print as Zudio Crosses 1,000-Store Mark
news.summary: Trent shares are establishing a sideways accumulation base near ₹2,580 after reporting a 25% YoY rise in consolidated Q2 net profit to ₹468 crore on revenue of ₹5,873 crore (up 22%). During the quarter, the retailer added its milestone 1,000th Zudio store, prompting institutional brokerages including Elara Capital to upgrade the stock citing long-term footprint compounding.
news.impact: Tightening price ranges on decreasing volume highlight a classic base-building process; watch for a break above local pivot levels around ₹2,620 to signal swing continuation.

news.headline: FIIs Buy Net ₹7,212 Crore on Dalal Street to Extend Buying Streak to Seven Sessions
news.summary: Provisional exchange data for November 9, 2026, showed Foreign Institutional Investors were net buyers of ₹7,212.22 crore in the cash segment, marking seven consecutive sessions of aggressive institutional purchases. In contrast, Domestic Institutional Investors recorded net sales of ₹7,172.53 crore, helping Nifty 50 close flat at 25,033.20.
news.impact: Strong liquidity backstop in large-cap cash counters prevents broad breakdown risk and supports multi-day base patterns across front-line indices.

news.headline: IRB Infrastructure Reports 85% YoY Jump in Q2 Net Profit Driven by Robust Toll Collections
news.summary: IRB Infrastructure Developers declared an 84.85% YoY increase in consolidated net profit to ₹260.15 crore for the September quarter of FY27, up from ₹141 crore in the year-ago period. Top-line expansion was driven by consistent traffic volume growth across its BOT/TOT assets and higher cash distributions from its InvIT vehicles.
news.impact: Strong operational earnings provide a fundamental tailwind for a technical rebound from lower swing boundaries, with support defined near recent lows.
